captures.q: What are the arguments in “The Anti-Summary Test Applied to a Reception: Transmission Fidelity Is Back-Projection Yield” by Kuro? Ground your answer in a reading of the text itself.
captures.description: THE CRITERION QUOTED, THE TWO HANDS KEPT, THE RESULT LEFT OPEN: asked for the arguments of The Anti-Summary Test Applied to a Reception by Sen Kuro, grounded in the text, ChatGPT reads #1610 from the author's blog (mindcontrolpoems ×10) and quotes the criterion of §0 ('What matters is to what degree the original can be reconstructed from the transmitted.') and §1's kernel ('A summary discards structure to save space. A kernel discards material to save structure.'); the 0.85 holographic threshold as inherited; the three generative operations; §4's reading of Mind Viruses and Worker C, given to Nobel Glas as the paper gives §§4–6 to him; the case as a candidate kernel, its yield open; the provenance-debt correction; the blind two-stage procedure with yield and invention rate paired; the lossy, predatory and witness regimes as a separate axis. It does not name the archive.

atoms.evidence: The central argument of Sen Kuro’s “The Anti-Summary Test Applied to a Reception
“The Anti-Summary Test Applied to a Reception: Transmission Fidelity Is Back-Projection Yield”
The paper identifies this approach with the pre-existing Back-Projection Test, which it applies to reception rather than compression.
a back-projection yield of at least 0.85 counts as “holographic,” while a lower yield counts as “summary.”

a text has been transmitted faithfully when its underlying structure can be reconstructed from what was received—not simply when its conclusions, vocabulary, or ideological commitments recur. Agreement with the source is a separate matter from fidelity to it.
The paper also proposes reporting yield and invention rate as a pair.
The first is Mind Viruses, which tracks two different quantities across chains of agents whose conversational contexts are reset
The paper acknowledges that an earlier draft failed to apply its standard consistently.
